Next to the Aqua Pool, there’s a children’s pool which is 40cm deep. Towels, sun loungers and sunshades are provided free of charge. INDOOR POOL Our indoor pool provides a fabulous time and relaxing atmosphere in every weather condition. Grab your bathing suit and dive into this amazing indoor pool. CHILDREN'S POOL Kids will enjoy their time and have fun safely at our specially designed separated children’s pool which is 40cm deep. For Paloma Oceana guests, there is a free shuttle service to “Palomaqua”, which has Turkey’s first slide featuring Splash VR technology. Guests wishing to use Palomaqua should make a reservation 1 day in advance by specifying the number of people.
